categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes CNetAddr routability logic in src/netaddress.cpp and address management tests in src/test/addrman_tests.cpp to prevent storing multicast IPs in addrman.
categories.rationale: Prevents gossiped multicast addresses from being accepted into addrman and wasting outbound connection slots. Commit d54f486882 notes that 'Gossiped multicast addresses were therefore accepted into addrman and could be selected for outbound connections.'
